title: Current Core 26 Player Species Canon Authority
authority_scope: Current player-species roster identity and forward-consumer canon. Historical 25-species evidence remains immutable history and cannot override this file while CURRENT.json references it.
derived_from: owner directive 2026-09-20: system going forward recognizes 26 as current canon and all 26 are raised to the same standard

Nekron.rule: Current-authority surfaces use Morganthyr; sealed historical evidence may retain Nekron/Nekrons only for reproducibility.

Nekrons.rule: Current-authority surfaces use Morganthyr; sealed historical evidence may retain Nekron/Nekrons only for reproducibility.

akwi.storage_rule: Supplemental physical storage does not make Akwi non-core. Current catalogs/pickers/validators must treat Akwi as a peer member of the Core 26.

ratman.taxonomy_rule: These are subordinate Ratman lineage/subspecies candidates, not peer Core-26 species. Exact rank and detailed biology remain source-bounded.

consumer_rules: Every current-authority player-species picker, creator, renderer, appearance system, runtime catalog, migration path, validator, authoring/search surface, NPC/Creature adapter and certification artifact must resolve this Core-26 authority.
No current-authority consumer may treat 23 content-db objects or the sealed historical 25-profile set as the complete current roster.
No current-authority consumer may expose Nekron/Nekrons as the canonical current identity; resolve to Morganthyr while retaining historical alias provenance.
Akwi must be treated as Core-26 even where its governed runtime object remains physically supplemental until catalog convergence.
Missing current objects, mechanics, visuals or source facts must be reported as production gaps; they may not be synthesized merely to achieve 26/26.
historical_preservation: Do not rewrite sealed PPIA-05, PPIA-06 or CAPP completion evidence merely to replace historical 25-species counts or Nekron wording.
Historical validators may reproduce historical heads, but they cannot certify current Core-26 completeness.
The old Evernote species renamed The Jee and the later Bougadahl remain outside the Core 26 unless separately owner-authorized.
